title: Blessed Be the Lord, My Rock

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord, my rock, who trains my hands for war, and my fingers for what?
He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my what?
O Lord, what is man that you regard him, or the son of man that you think of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:3 (ESV): "or the son of man that you think of him?"

questions.question: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:4 (ESV): "his days are like a passing shadow."

questions.question: Bow your heavens, O Lord, and come down! Touch the mountains so that they do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:5 (ESV): "Touch the mountains so that they smoke!"

questions.question: Flash forth lightning and scatter them; send out your arrows and rout whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:6 (ESV): "send out your arrows and rout them!"

questions.question: Stretch out your hand from on high; rescue me and deliver me from the many what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:7 (ESV): "rescue me and deliver me from the many waters,"

questions.question: From the hand of foreigners, whose mouths speak lies and whose right hand is a right hand of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:8 (ESV): "and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood."

questions.question: I will sing a new song to you, O God; upon a ten-stringed harp I will play to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:9 (ESV): "upon a ten-stringed harp I will play to you,"

questions.question: Who gives victory to kings; who rescues David his servant from the cruel what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:10 (ESV): "who rescues David his servant from the cruel sword."

questions.question: May our sons in their youth be like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:12 (ESV): "May our sons in their youth be like plants full grown,"

questions.question: May our daughters be like corner pillars cut for the structure of a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:12 (ESV): "our daughters like corner pillars cut for the structure of a palace;"

questions.question: May our granaries be full, providing all kinds of what?
May our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our what?
Blessed are the people to whom such blessings fall! Blessed are the people whose God is whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 144:15 (ESV): "Blessed are the people whose God is the Lord!"

key_verse_text: Blessed be the Lord, my rock, who trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battle;
